results.note: Official GRP photo of a rescued gibbon eating fruit beside its forest enclosure fence. The listed candidate (1-hour.png) was rejected because it is a square promo graphic with large text and a BOOK button. Commons has no photos of the project; this one came from the site's media library.

Golden boulder stupa at the Wat Koh Sirey hilltop temple, with the sea and islands behind. A small ©WillyThuan mark at the bottom-left falls outside a centred 16:9 crop. Candidates rejected: the phuket101 og:image is a generic beach with a speedboat, and the thaiholidayguide image is a hazy harbour view; neither shows the temple or the village. Commons has nothing for Koh Sirey (its 'Wat Ko Si Re' category is the Nai Harn temple).

results.credit: กสิณธร ราชโอรส
results.note: Close, sharp view of the half-buried golden Buddha inside the vihara, taken from the same 2024 Commons series as the candidates. I picked it over candidate 1 (a plain vihara exterior) and candidate 2 (the same Buddha from farther away, with a NO ENTRY sign in the middle of the frame).

2025 photo of the museum's pink colonial-style main building, seen through the entrance arch with a traditional wooden boat in front. A small '© Phuket 101' mark at the bottom-right falls outside a centred 16:9 crop. The candidate (thaiholidayguide) was rejected: a soft image of the indoor street diorama with a songthaew, which looks like Old Town rather than a mining museum. Commons has no photos and no official museum site was found.

results.credit: U.S. Navy photo by Seaman Apprentice Christian Kibler
results.note: A volunteer walking a rescued ginger dog along a path in the Soi Dog sanctuary (Nov 2024), sharp and landscape. The candidate was rejected as a dim 3:4 portrait of two dogs under a kennel platform. The official visit-page photos are too small (785 px or less) or show merchandise.

Candidate 1: Wat Karon (Wat Suwan Khiri Khet) ordination hall with its naga staircase, on the temple grounds where the market is held. A small ©WillyThuan mark at the bottom-right falls outside a centred 16:9 crop. Candidate 2 (Commons 'Karon Tempel - panoramio') was rejected because it appears to show Wat Chalong's main hall, so the label looks wrong. The only other Commons photo (Patak Road with the temple gate) is too cluttered with wires and shop signs.

Candidate 1: the Kruvit Raft deck at dusk, with diners under lit roofs over the water (the page confirms it is Kruvit Raft). A small ©WillyThuan mark at the bottom-left falls outside a centred 16:9 crop. The official site kruvitraft.com is unreachable and Commons has no photos.

Candidate 1: the hillside deck with low tables and floor cushions, looking out over Koh Man and the sea. A small '© Phuket 101' mark at the bottom-right falls outside a centred 16:9 crop. No official website was found (social media only).

Candidate 1: the hilltop terrace with rattan seating and a wide view over Chalong and the bay. A small '© Phuket 101' mark and a thin stitched strip run along the bottom edge; both fall outside a centred 16:9 crop. No official site was found, only booking listings.
